statement: ∀ (j : Fin n) (y : Other n j) (R t : ℝ), (∫ z in Icc (-R) R, dx (flux u j) j (WaveEnergy.insert j (y,z),t)) = (∫ z in Icc (-R) R, dx (flux u j) j (Function.update (WaveEnergy.insert j (y,0)) j z,t))
proof:
intro j y R t
apply integral_congr_ae
apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
intro z
have hup : WaveEnergy.insert j (y,z) =
    Function.update (WaveEnergy.insert j (y,0)) j z := by
  funext i
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst i
    simp [WaveEnergy.insert]
  · simp [WaveEnergy.insert, h]
exact congrArg (fun x : X n => dx (flux u j) j (x,t)) hup
